Name: Dating Haley
Author: kabulla
Description:
Haley is one of the most underrated bachellorettes of the game. At first, she seems to be a typical frivolous young woman, but as you get to know her better, her character develops beautifully!

This MOD adds several events while dating Haley. It won't work if you are engaged or already married with her. It needs Content Patcher and SMAPI to work. It's compatible with most MODs, even Stardew Valley Expanded. 


Above, additional requirements to trigger each event:



[list]
[*]Beach 1: 10am to 5pm, Monday to Thursday in Summer, sunny, 8 hearts or more.
[*]Beach 2: 10am to 5pm, Friday to Sunday in Summer, sunny, 9 hearts or more.
[*]Beach 3: 10am to 5pm, Monday to Thursday in Summer, sunny, 9 hearts or more.
[*]Town 1: Monday to Thursday afternoons, 8 hearts or more
[*]Town 2: Friday to Sunday after 7pm, 9 hearts or more
[*]Town 3: Monday to Thursday after 5pm, 10 hearts or more
[*]House 0: Friday to Sunday afternoons, 8 hearts or more
[*]House 1: Monday to Thursday afternoons, 8 hearts or more
[*]House 2: Friday to Sunday afternoons, 10 hearts or more
[*]House 3: Monday to Thursday afternoons, 10 hearts or more, have seen her 10 hearts event 
[*]House 4: Friday to Sunday afternoons, 10 hearts or more
[*]House 5: Monday to Thursday afternoons, 10 hearts or more 
[/list]

-x-x-x-

PT-BR
[b]Este MOD já está traduzido para português.[/b]

Haley é uma das NPC's menos valorizadas no jogo. No início, ela parece ser uma típica garota frívola, mas ao conhecê-la melhor, sua personalidade e sua história se desenvolvem lindamente.

Este MOD adiciona vários eventos que surgem enquanto você está namorando a Haley. Não funcionará mais quando você pedi-la em casamento ou se casar com ela. É necessário o Content Patcher e SMAPI para funcionar.

Downloads.Description: Changes Haley sprites in beach events and bug fixes.
